obernants.observation_scope: Values, shape, errors and named assertions
obernants.operator: In the universe of terminating finite fixture runs and pass/fail reports, absent pairs are false acceptance or false rejection relative to the assertion conjunction. Abort and nontermination are excluded; finite observations support only this scope.
obernants.assumptions: Prime field, declared resource domain and successful allocations

obernants.observation_scope: Values, shape, errors and named assertions
obernants.operator: A pass admits all candidate implementations agreeing on the finite fixtures, including arbitrary off-fixture differences. Failure admits defective production or defective oracle. Neither observation uniquely recovers a cause.
obernants.assumptions: Prime field, declared resource domain and successful allocations

obernants.observation_scope: Values, shape, errors and named assertions
obernants.operator: Row reduction solves Hankel consistency for every candidate order, using extended Euclid inversion rather than production discrepancy updates/Fermat inversion. Direct modular dot products independently check returned coefficients; the Kitamasa join is additional evidence only.
obernants.assumptions: Prime field, declared resource domain and successful allocations

obernants.observation_scope: Values, shape, errors and named assertions
obernants.operator: Compile a purpose-specific false oracle; its named assertion must fail. Production mutants are separately compiled and rejected. Restore exact source bytes before positive rechecks and syntax generation. Sensitivity applies only to selected controls.
obernants.assumptions: Prime field, declared resource domain and successful allocations

obernants.observation_scope: Values, shape, errors and named assertions
obernants.operator: Enumerate sum(n=0..7)3^n=3280 prefixes, compare minimum feasible Gaussian order and direct compatibility. Also test lag orientation, a generated recurrence continuation, all-zero and delayed impulse, full-width normalization and cap boundary.
obernants.assumptions: Prime field, declared resource domain and successful allocations
